meta.title: Nothing, Forever: AI Sitcom Live Since 2023
meta.description: Nothing, Forever is the AI-generated sitcom that has streamed on Twitch since early 2023 — dialogue, jokes, and scenes written live by AI, around the clock.

h1: Nothing, Forever: the sitcom that never wraps

faqs.a: Yes — the channel has kept streaming its AI-generated sitcom continuously since going live in early 2023. It airs around the clock on Twitch at watchmeforever.
AI does — dialogue, jokes, scenes, and even the stand-up bits are generated live. The human team (Mismatch Media) built the show; the machine keeps it on air.

faqs.q: Why is it low-poly and Seinfeld-style?
faqs.a: That's the premise the show launched with: a blocky apartment-comedy world in the Seinfeld tradition. The standing format is part of what proved an always-on AI sitcom could hold an audience.
